retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel ensemble portrait using vertical color-blocked stripes and high-contrast grayscale subjects to create a rhythmic, modern pop aesthetic.
triggerTerms: high contrast grayscale on red and orange
excludeWhen: a single unified background is required
soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition divided into five vertical columns of alternating red and orange. Each column features a high-contrast grayscale headshot of a different male subject, positioned at varying heights. The bottom half of the image is a solid black void where the subjects' torsos merge.
coreVisualRelationships: Grayscale subjects against vibrant saturated backgrounds
Rhythmic vertical alignment of multiple portraits
Solid black base anchoring the composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white skin tones
Subjects wearing black clothing to merge with the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged horizontally, each occupying one vertical stripe; heads are scaled to fill the width of their respective columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid black horizontal band across the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A rhythmic left-to-right scan following the alternating colors and the varying eye levels of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black area at the bottom provides a heavy visual weight and negative space for potential text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background contrasts with the zero-saturation grayscale subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Stacked smaller text for conjunctions within the main title line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the display text.
Provides the clean, tall, condensed sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a background of five vertical stripes alternating between vibrant red and deep orange. Place five high-contrast grayscale portraits of men, one in each stripe, with their torsos merging into a solid black base at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed black sans-serif text across the top of the stripes. Include a secondary vertical text element in white on the far right stripe.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly five vertical color stripes?
Is the text a heavy, condensed sans-serif?
Does the bottom of the image fade into solid black?

mustRedesign: Any use of soft gradients in the background
Low-contrast or color photography for the subjects

mustAchieve: Extreme contrast between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean vertical alignment of stripes.
Ensure subjects do not have color tinting.
Verify the black base is a solid, uniform color.
Confirm text is legible against the saturated background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Stripe Montage + High-Contrast Grayscale Portraits + Bold Condensed Sans-Serif
